item.title: Nearly 100 animals rescued from snow, cold by Memphis Animal Services
item.description: MEMPHIS, Tenn. -- The Memphis animal shelter is at capacity and in urgent need of foster families and adopters after rescuing nearly 100 animals from dangerous weather conditions. Since Saturday, Memphis Animal Services says it has taken in 72 animals, including strays and pets left to fend for themselves in the snow and freezing temperatures. [...]
